metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: As a fan of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this iconic teen comedy offers the same witty dialogue and sharp social commentary.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Matches the ensemble comedy and high-stakes adventure found in Dungeons & Dragons and Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: This fast-paced action-comedy delivers the same blend of clever writing and physical humor as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A perfect blend of fantasy, romance, and comedy that aligns with the whimsical nature of Practical Magic and D&D.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Captures the vibrant, uplifting energy and fashion-forward protagonist seen in Clueless.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A magical adventure that bridges the gap between the fantasy of Fantastic Beasts and the romance of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by the same creator as The Nice Guys, this film features witty banter and a fun crime-solving dynamic.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Like Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, this film uses a high-concept gaming world for feel-good action and humor.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Features a smart-talking female lead and clever high school themes similar to 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: Offers high-octane fun and colorful action sequences that fans of Thor: Ragnarok will enjoy.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A classic adventure comedy that hits the same 'fun journey' beats as Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: Fans of the mockumentary style and irreverent humor in Brüno will appreciate this Lonely Island parody.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A high-energy action-comedy with great chemistry between the leads, similar to Jumanji.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Anachronistic and fun, it blends 90s teen movie vibes with a fantasy-lite adventure setting.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A vibrant, fast-paced animation that matches the energy and visual creativity of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Delivers the stylish, over-the-top action and comedic tone present in Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A smart, lighthearted rom-com with a sci-fi twist that feels fresh and fun.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: If you liked Ace Ventura, this is another essential high-energy Jim Carrey comedy with fantasy elements.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that prioritizes fun, heart, and humor over dark grit, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A feel-good romance with a magical time-travel element that matches the warmth of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A masterclass in buddy-cop comedy that fans of The Nice Guys will find hilarious and well-paced.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A charming blend of romance, fantasy, and comedy that feels like a modern fairy tale.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Visually inventive and extremely fast-paced, aligning with the energy of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A lighthearted adventure comedy that echoes the vibe of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A quintessential 2000s teen comedy that pairs perfectly with Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Uplifting and funny with a great ensemble cast, perfect for a relaxing movie night.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: Features the same kind of absurd, character-driven humor found in Ace Ventura and Brüno.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: A high-octane action film that uses meta-humor and irreverence much like Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A modern Shakespeare adaptation (Twelfth Night) that follows the tradition of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Its unique animation style and fast-paced humor make it a great companion to Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy that captures the same sense of fun and 'unlikely heroes' found in Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Step Brothers
metas.description: For the viewer who enjoyed the broad, loud, and unapologetic comedy of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: School of Rock
metas.description: An incredibly feel-good movie with great energy and comedic timing that is easy to watch.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A high-energy action-comedy that subverts tropes with a lot of laugh-out-loud moments.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern take on the teen comedy genre that captures the spirit and wit of Clueless.

metas.name: The Birdcage
metas.description: A vibrant and hilarious feel-good comedy that relies on fantastic performances and comedic chaos.

metas.name: Mystery Men
metas.description: A hidden gem superhero comedy that matches the quirky, ensemble-driven humor of D&D.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: Though a zombie film, it is primarily a very lighthearted and funny buddy comedy about friendship.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A classic fun action-adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously, much like Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Kung Fu Hustle
metas.description: A highly stylized and hilarious action movie that feels like a live-action cartoon, similar to the energy of Night Is Short.
